full_text:
Most engineering teams are building AI agents completely wrong.

Connecting LLMs directly to APIs without deterministic state machines causes 42% loop degradation after 3 turns.

Deploying stateful LangGraph DAG architectures with memory checkpoints drops latency to sub-300ms while hitting 99.4% task completion.

Stop shipping naive prompt wrappers. Build resilient agent loops.

How is your engineering team handling agent loop state persistence in production?
